// The clean half of that pair. The minting module imports node:crypto and one
// alphabet, touches no database, and returns a string. One generator serves the
// teacher's own rotation and the operator's, which is what reuse has to mean:
// two that agreed when they were written and drifted afterwards would be worse
// than one obvious duplication.
import "server-only";
import { makeFamilyCode } from "@/lib/familyCodeMint";

export function candidate() {
  return makeFamilyCode();
}
